hints.title: Coordinate Frequency Tracking
hints.text: Store coordinates in a frequency table mapping each coordinate pair to its insertion count.

hints.title: Diagonal Partner Search
hints.text: For a query point (qx, qy), iterate over all stored points (x, y) that form a valid non-degenerate square diagonal.

hints.title: Side Length and Corner Multiplicity
hints.text: A valid square requires absolute differences in x and y to be non-zero and equal. Multiply corner counts (qx, y) and (x, qy).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) for add and O(P) for count where P is the number of distinct inserted points
variables: P: number of unique stored points
complexity.notes: Checking diagonal corners via hash table lookups is O(1) per distinct point.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all inserted points instead of distinct points repeats work for duplicate coordinates.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash table lookup replaces quadratic corner search with linear diagonal verification.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize axis-aligned square geometry from diagonal points and multiply frequencies.
